urdu.name: میسرہ

faq.q: What is the origin of Maysara?
faq.a: Maysara is associated with Arabic. Maysara is Arabic مَيْسَرَة (Maysara) 'ease, facility, convenience', from the root ي س ر (y-s-r). The source gloss 'Easy-going, Gentle' is broadly consistent. Same name as maysarah.

faq.q: What does Maysara mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Maysara is rendered میسرہ and carries the sense آسانی، سہولت، آسودگی.

faq.q: What does Maysara mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Maysara is rendered میسره and carries the sense آسانی، سهولت، راحتی.
A romanized syllable approximation is may-sa-ra. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Maysara?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Maysara, maysara. Script forms are ميسرة, میسره, میسرہ, मैसरा.

faq.q: Is Maysara a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
